description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Serko is hiring a Software Engineer 1 to help build the application experience layer, including web applications, BFF layers, and orchestration services. The role delivers supported, well-scoped work to production and uses AI agents with careful review and validation.
Software Engineer 1 contributing to web applications, Backend-for-Frontend layers, and orchestration services connecting products to core platforms

Responsibilities:
• Build the experience layer: Contribute to our web applications, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers, and orchestration services that connect our products to core platform services
• Ship to production: Deliver well-scoped features with team support while learning our standards for accessibility and craft
• Work agentically: Use AI agents in your daily workflow, developing the judgment to thoroughly review, validate, and own everything you and your agents ship

Requirements:
• Curious, eager learners who want to grow fast with strong mentorship and team support
• Collaborative builders who care about crafting accessible, high-quality customer experiences
• AI-forward thinkers excited to work agentically from day one while maintaining high engineering standards
• Foundational experience in web development and backend services (through internships, projects, or early-career roles)
• A strong desire to learn modern engineering, accessibility, and production best practices
• Curiosity about AI-assisted development, paired with attention to detail and a willingness to check your work carefully
